# 🪝 Always-on skills

Keeps always-apply skill invariants, such as unslop-tests, in force for the whole session, and restates the relevant one after each edit to a file in its scope.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install always-on-skills@jaktestowac`. The hook runs `node`, so Node.js must be on your PATH.

To change the configuration, copy [`hooks/always-on-skills.json`](hooks/always-on-skills.json) to `.claude/always-on-skills.json` in your project and edit it there. The project copy wins over the one bundled with the plugin.
